# Void share of the random web varied (surround + exp-lock gradient, compensated clumps, bare, 1,000 layouts per row)

Zero net contrast kept: total void deficit = total cluster mass in every layout. Fewer voids → each void carries more deficit: it deepens from δ = −0.5 down to δ = −1 (completely empty, the cap), and beyond that it gets larger. More voids → each is shallower. 'random' = each layout draws its void share uniformly from 0–100% (at least 1 void and 1 cluster). f_v = 50% reproduces the with_clumps run.
